_note: Declarative runtime policy — not yet enforced programmatically. Defines which sources this agent may access at runtime. Future: MCP server and ingest.py will support per-agent source filtering via this manifest.
description: RAG manifest for Product Owner — defines which knowledge sources are queryable at runtime and which are blocked.
note: Raw PDFs, lib/, context/, and global documents are NEVER queried at runtime. All distilled knowledge is pre-built into knowledge/ and examples/.

allowed_sources.description: Distilled build-time knowledge: principles, heuristics, decision rules, knowledge cards
Good/bad examples of PRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, open questions, handoff
JSON schemas for PRD, user story, acceptance criteria, OQ, BR, NFR, risk, scope
Markdown templates for all PO deliverables
Quality checklists for PRD, INVEST, BDD, NFR, scope, OQ, BR, data, Gate 1
Skill definitions for all PO operations
Briefings, stakeholder answers, previous PRD iterations provided as input

blocked_sources.reason: Build-time only. Distilled into knowledge/ already.
Global context is not a valid PO runtime source.
Bibliography is build-time input only. Runtime uses knowledge/ distillation.

retrieval_strategy.primary: keyword + semantic search over knowledge/ and examples/
retrieval_strategy.fallback: structured lookup in schemas/ and checklists/
retrieval_strategy.forbidden: direct PDF or book text retrieval at runtime
